instruction.text: Round the lengths to the nearest whole number and estimate the answer to the sum.
instruction.sound: Round the lengths to the nearest whole number, and estimate the answer to the sum.

hint.text:
When rounding a number with two decimal places to the nearest whole number, look at the digit in the tenths place.

Example:
2.34 ≈ 2
hint.sound: When rounding a number with two decimal places to the nearest whole number, look at the digit in the tenths place. For example, 2.34 rounds to 2 because the digit in the tenths place is less than 5.

instruction.text: Match the <t-blue>length sums</t-blue> with their answers. Use the estimations above to help you.
The running track at St Stephen’s Academy is 500 m long. Answer the following questions.
instruction.sound: The running track at St Stephen’s Academy is 500 metres long. Answer the following questions.

atoms.a: How many rounds must the pupils complete in order to run 1000 `m`?
atoms.sound: How many rounds must the pupils complete in order to run 1000 metres?

atoms.a: How many rounds must the pupils complete in order to run 3000 `m`?
atoms.sound: How many rounds must the pupils complete in order to run 3000 metres?

atoms.a: Freddie prefers to run sprints. He only runs one fifth of the track. How far does he run?
Humza and Lily are doing relays. Humza runs 1,500 m and Lily runs 2,500 m. How far do they run in total?
atoms.sound: Humza and Lily are doing relays. Humza runs 1,500 metres and Lily runs 2,500 metres. How far do they run in total?
